brief:
The UK consulate in East Jerusalem is preparing to close, marking a new low in British-Israeli relations, The Guardian reported. The forced closure comes amid reports that Britain is considering expelling Israeli diplomats from London in retaliation.

The closure represents a significant diplomatic rupture between the two countries. Palestinian officials have warned that Palestinians will bear the cost of the shutdown, which affects services the consulate provided to residents of East Jerusalem.

title: UK shuts East Jerusalem consulate as UK-Israeli tensions escalate
